notes.title: Air Bounce - Update I
notes.notes:
We have improved the following:
- The player handling itself has been improved.
- The Mouse handling and fixed several minor bugs regarding the mouse handling have been done.
- We have improved and balanced some of the levels.
- We have fixed the one impossible level (it is now possible again).
- The menu handling has been improved.

We hope you like the changes and fixes and hope you have a lot of fun playing the game.

See you soon.
